title: Integrate analysis chain and snapshot publication into processBlock
description:
Modify Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp only, to run the analysis chain at bounded control-rate cadence and publish the adaptive snapshot to the voices.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/Analysis/AdaptiveSnapshot.h (h.1) for the publisher API.
- Source/DSP/DelayVoice.h (h.2) for applyAdaptiveSnapshot's signature and call site expectations.
- Source/Analysis/ for the existing anti-alias filter, stateful sample-rate converter, analyzer, onset detector, density estimator, sustain estimator, and adaptive controller classes and their step/process entry points.
- Source/PluginProcessor.cpp for the existing prepareToPlay allocation block, the existing pre-delay analysis tap, and the existing control-rate cadence counter if one already exists.

Work required:
1. Add as members an AdaptiveSnapshotPublisher, a reusable AdaptiveSnapshot scratch instance, and a control-rate block counter. Allocate all analysis-chain buffers, the resampler state, and the anti-alias filter state in prepareToPlay only, sized for the maximum block size and channel count. The analyzer runs at a fixed internal 48000 Hz analysis rate behind the anti-alias filter and the stateful sample-rate converter regardless of the host sample rate; reset all analysis state in prepareToPlay.
2. In processBlock, with juce::ScopedNoDenormals already at the top: feed the resampler from the existing pre-delay analysis tap, then at a bounded control-rate cadence (a fixed number of samples per control step, never a per-sample or unbounded loop) step the analyzer, onset, density, and sustain estimators and then the adaptive controller. Fill the scratch AdaptiveSnapshot from the controller output (contraction, bloom, mode, and per-voice deltas) and call publisher.publish(). Immediately before the voices process, call publisher.read() into a member snapshot and pass it to each voice via applyAdaptiveSnapshot with that voice's index; on a failed read, reuse the previously read snapshot.
3. Off mode must be a provably static path: when the adaptive mode parameter is Off, do not step the analysis chain and publish a default-constructed (all-zero) AdaptiveSnapshot exactly once on the transition into Off, so the rendered output is sample-identical to the non-adaptive static path within floating-point determinism.
4. No heap allocation, lock, file IO, string construction, GUI call, unbounded loop, buffer resize, or FFT allocation may be introduced into processBlock. The adaptive path must not call setValueNotifyingHost and must not rewrite base APVTS values.

Do not modify DelayVoice, AdaptiveSnapshot.h, CMakeLists.txt, tests, or anything under JUCE/.
acceptance_criteria: Source/PluginProcessor.h declares an AdaptiveSnapshotPublisher member, a member AdaptiveSnapshot, and a control-rate cadence counter
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp allocates and resets all analysis-chain, resampler, and anti-alias state in prepareToPlay and allocates nothing in processBlock
processBlock feeds the resampler from the pre-delay analysis tap and steps analyzer, onset, density, sustain, and adaptive controller at a bounded control-rate cadence with no unbounded loop
processBlock publishes the snapshot through AdaptiveSnapshotPublisher::publish and reads it back via read() before calling DelayVoice::applyAdaptiveSnapshot for each voice with its voice index
When adaptive mode is Off the analysis chain is not stepped and an all-zero snapshot is published, making the signal path static
The analyzer runs at a fixed internal 48000 Hz analysis rate behind the anti-alias filter and stateful sample-rate converter regardless of host sample rate
processBlock contains juce::ScopedNoDenormals and adds no heap allocation, lock, file IO, string construction, GUI call, or buffer resize
Source/PluginProcessor.cpp adds no setValueNotifyingHost call on the adaptive path
cmake --build build --target ShredSpace_VST3 succeeds and cmake --build build --target ShredSpace_Standalone succeeds after this change
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: allocate memory, lock, perform file IO, construct strings, or resize buffers inside processBlock
run the analyzer at the host sample rate instead of the fixed 48000 Hz internal analysis rate
step the analysis chain per sample or in an unbounded loop
call setValueNotifyingHost or rewrite base APVTS values from the adaptive path

allowed: choose the exact control-rate cadence in samples, as a named constant
add private members for analysis scratch buffers sized in prepareToPlay
add a private helper that fills the scratch AdaptiveSnapshot from the controller output
forbidden: change the plugin bus layout support or parameter layout
introduce a new threading model or background worker for analysis
change the AdaptiveSnapshot schema or the publisher API
